description: This file defines the LocationCaptureManager class which handles location fetching, permissions checks, and location caching for an Android app.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages location requests, caching, and permissions for obtaining device location in an Android app.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location, either from cache or by requesting a fresh fix.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Gets the most recent last known location if it satisfies the age constraints and permissions are granted.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests the current location from the location provider with a timeout.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Suspends and obtains a location either from cache or by requesting a new fix, and returns it as a Payload JSON.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Returns the most recent last known Location within the max age constraints if permissions are granted.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests a fresh Location fix from the provider with a timeout.
